tool.name: Parametric Tokamak Coil Generator
tool.description: Generate TF and PF coil geometry for a tokamak as a 3D plot and tagged coordinate table

param.name: major_radius
param.label: Major radius R0 (m)
param.help: Distance from the torus centre to the centre of each TF coil

param.name: tf_coil_radius
param.label: TF coil loop radius (m)
param.help: Radius of each toroidal field coil loop

param.name: n_tf_coils
param.label: Number of TF coils
param.help: Number of toroidal field coils evenly spaced in toroidal angle

param.name: pf_coil_radius
param.label: PF coil ring radius (m)
param.help: Radius of the PF coil rings from the machine axis

param.name: pf_coil_z
param.label: PF coil distance from midplane (m)
param.help: Axial distance of the upper and lower poloidal field coils from the device midplane

param.name: n_points
param.label: Points per coil loop
param.help: Number of coordinate points used to discretise each coil

data.name: output_png
data.label: Coil geometry plot
data.help: 3D visualisation of TF and PF coil positions

data.name: output_csv
data.label: Coil coordinate data
data.help: Tab-separated coordinate table tagged by coil ID and type for MFEM/MOOSE input

tool.help:
**Parametric Tokamak Coil Generator**
Produces line-model geometry for the toroidal field (TF) and poloidal field (PF) coils of a tokamak.
The origin is at the centre of the torus (where the major radius is measured). All coils are modelled as closed loops of 3D coordinate points.
**TF coils** are evenly distributed in toroidal angle and each lie in the poloidal plane at their respective angle.
**PF coils** are two horizontal rings (upper and lower) at +/-Z from the midplane, centred on the machine axis at the major radius.
The tabular output tags every point with coil_id and coil_type so downstream MFEM/MOOSE parsers can identify individual coil circuits.
